To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) poly ADP-ribosylation is an important mechanism in the regulation of DNA metabolism in cardiomyocytes and non-cardiocytes of the rat heart; 2) in the rat heart, poly ADP-R synthesis is cell-specifically regulated; 3) in the rat myocardium, poly ADP- ribosylation is a differentiation-dependent process; and 4) poly ADP-R metabolism is regulated by circulatory stress.
the polymer metabolism of cardiac cells is differentially regulated in a cell specific manner.
the circulatory stress induced by the coarctation of the aorta in rats is followed by a significant increase in the activity of poly ADP-R in non-cardiocytes and by a decrease in cardiocytes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the regulation of poly ADP-R synthesis in the heart.
the regulation and the functional role of poly ADP-R in cardiac nuclei.
the regulation of polymer metabolism during cardiac differentiation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the circulatory stress induces a differentiation dependent response in cardiac cells.

the poly ADP-R synthesis in cardiocytes and non-cardiocytes is differentially regulated in response to circulatory stress, and the regulation is dependent on the differentiation of cardiocytes and noncardiocytes.
the response of poly ADP-R to circulatory stress depends on the cell type and that poly ADP-R metabolism is regulated by the differentiation state.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in cardiocytes, poly ADP-R is an inhibitor of DNA synthesis, while in non-cardiocytes it is a stimulant.

the polymer metabolism is highly differentiated in cardiocytes and noncardiocytes, and that the differentiation dependent regulation of the polymer metabolism is not a simple reflection of the differentiation dependent regulation in the DNA metabolism.
poly ADP-R is a key regulator of the cell cycle and that the synthesis of poly ADP-R may serve as a marker for the cell cycle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a strong correlation between poly ADP-ribose synthesis and DNA synthesis, and this relationship may be cell specific.
the circulatory stress induces a cell specific response of poly ADP-R synthesis in the cardiac tissue.
the circulatory system is not just a passive conduit for blood, but is a dynamic organ that responds to stress and injury.
